research_scope: Remote Serious Bomb — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Remote Serious Bomb as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a two-part, multi-hitting debuff sequence and a 300 Ki cost per activation stage.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists 80% Tokipedia completion as the unlock route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes Tokipedia completion rather than a Parallel Quest reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.variant_policy: DUAL Remote Serious Bomb is a separate Dual Ultimate identity and is not merged into this record.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.

records.name: Remote Serious Bomb
records.character_source: Fu and customizable partner documented by current references
records.skill_description: Seal the opponent's Awoken Skills with a Ki sign, then use the attack again to generate and launch a Serious Bomb.
records.mechanics_notes: The first activation places a seal on the locked-on opponent. The seal disables an active transformation and prevents transformation use while it lasts. A second activation while the seal is present converts it into the Serious Bomb, which detonates at the opponent's location if it connects. Each part uses 300 Ki according to the current reference.
